svg.title: Suspected lymphoma: excisional biopsy and staging first, then Hodgkin (classical or nodular lymphocyte-predominant, treated by stage) or non-Hodgkin, aggressive (diffuse large B-cell, R-CHOP) or indolent (follicular, watch and wait until symptomatic); Ann Arbor stage sets the treatment

svg.text: Suspected lymphoma: get TISSUE, then HODGKIN or NON-HODGKIN, then STAGE

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 1 · biopsy: EXCISIONAL > core > fine-needle aspiration (FNA loses node architecture)

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 · bloods (CBC, LDH, hepatitis B + C, HIV) · PET-CT · marrow if indicated · cardiac function · lumbar puncture for CNS

text.font-family: Arial, 'Segoe UI Symbol', 'Liberation Sans', Helvetica, sans-serif

svg.text: 3 · Ann Arbor: I one region · II ≥ 2, SAME side of diaphragm · III BOTH sides · IV diffuse extranodal (marrow) · B = B symptoms

svg.text: NON-HODGKIN (NHL): older · nodal or extranodal · MONOCLONAL on

svg.text: AGGRESSIVE → treat now · INDOLENT and well → watch and wait
